subject: Conversion request: Senior PM contractor -> FTE (comp band uplift & offer approval)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Conversion request: Senior PM contractor -> FTE (comp band uplift & offer approval)

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Quick one: Taylor Reed (contractor on Realtime Serving) submitted their resignation from TalentBridge effective 9/30 and the team is pushing to convert rather than re-hire externally. Taylor has been leading the payments integration work for the last 10 months and is already ramped.

Ask: Approve conversion to an FTE Senior PM (level PM-3) and permission to offer an uplifted comp package (see suggested ranges below). We need signoff for:
- Base + target bonus + equity band
- Using the existing open headcount (req WORKDAY-REQ-2026-0453) for conversion vs opening a new req

Why conversion: minimal ramp, immediate impact on roadmap commitments, lower total cost vs new hire in Q4 when external market pushes base higher.

Candidate snapshot attached: candidate_packet_TaylorReed.pdf (resume, perf notes, contractor rate history).
Suggested offer (internal recommendation):
- Base: $152,000–165,000
- Target bonus: 10%
- Equity: 0.10%–0.15% RSU (4-year vest)

Marissa — can you prepare a formal offer if we get approvals? Marcus/Finance — please confirm budget/headroom or reallocation options. Neha — please recommend final band and flag any policy issues for contractor conversion.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conversion request: Senior PM contractor -> FTE (comp band uplift & offer approval)

Thanks for the context, Mina — reviewed Taylor's packet. Good candidate and reasonable ask.

HR recommendation:
- Level: PM-3 (Senior PM)
- Comp band (market competitive for PM-3 in SF): Base $150k–170k, target bonus 8–12%, equity 0.08%–0.16% RSU.
- For internal contractor conversions, standard practice is to include a conversion addendum noting prior contractor period, no double-dipping on contractor pay, and typical 6-month probation for benefits.

I've attached a comp band sheet (comp_band_recommendation_Q3.xlsx) with suggested target packages for three scenarios (conservative / market / stretch). If you want to land quickly, I recommend market band: $158k base + 10% bonus + 0.12% RSU.

One flag: the mid-point (market scenario) would exceed the original budgeted FTE for this headcount by ~18% annualized. Finance confirmation needed to approve the delta or to reallocate from open requisitions.

If approved, I can draft the offer language and conversion addendum for legal review.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
People Partner, Talent Acquisition
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-03T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conversion request: Senior PM contractor -> FTE (comp band uplift & offer approval)

Mina / Neha — reviewed the numbers. Short answer: we can cover the uplift if we reassign budget from one unfilled SDE req (WORKDAY-REQ-2026-0419) that we plan to de-prioritize this quarter. That covers ~85% of the delta.

Notes:
- Cost impact FY26 (pro-rated): ~$18k–22k depending on exact base/equity payout timing.
- Approver required: Rishi (VP Product) needs to sign off on headcount reallocation and any uplift >15% over original band.
- Chargeback GL: 4012-Prod-Core (use internal code) — we have headroom in this GL after the SDE reallocation.

If Rishi approves, finance will mark the budget and Marissa can proceed with comp offer.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Strategic FP&A

To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conversion request: Senior PM contractor -> FTE (comp band uplift & offer approval)

Mina — thanks for the write-up. I reviewed Taylor's work with the Realtime team and agree conversion is the right move. Approve the conversion and the market scenario compensation (example: $162,000 base + 10% bonus + 0.12% RSU).

Conditions:
1) Use the SDE req budget reallocation Marcus proposed (WORKDAY-REQ-2026-0419).
2) Offer must include a standard conversion addendum and 4-year RSU schedule.
3) Candidate acceptance deadline: Sept 10, 2026. If not accepted, we will re-evaluate opening to external search in Q4.

Marissa — proceed to extend offer per HR template and copy legal on the packet. Neha — confirm benefits start date aligns with conversion addendum.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product

Subject: Offer: Senior Product Manager (Redwood Inference)

Taylor — great to speak yesterday. We're excited about the possibility of you joining the Realtime Serving team. Attached is the formal offer (offer_letter_TaylorReed_v1.pdf) and the conversion addendum. Key terms (summary):
- Title: Senior Product Manager (PM-3)
- Base salary: $162,000
- Target bonus: 10% (annual)
- Equity: 0.12% RSU grant on 4-year vest schedule
- Start date: flexible — we proposed Oct 4, 2026
- Benefits: standard Redwood benefits; benefits effective first of month after start (see addendum)

Please review and let me know any questions. If you're comfortable we need a signed copy by 11:59pm PT on Sept 10 to hold this package.

Attachments: offer_letter_TaylorReed_v1.pdf (offer), conversion_addendum_TaylorReed_v1.pdf (conversion terms)

Thanks,
Mina
